title: Octopus CEO loses control of 8 departments
storyboard: Film: none; AI-generate an octopus in a suit chairing a meeting of 8 arms; label clips AI-generated

scenes.headline: Breaking: octopus CEO loses control of 8 departments
Each arm basically runs its own office
scenes.body: About two-thirds of an octopus's neurons are in its arms, not its head.

scenes.headline: Meanwhile, HR has three hearts to manage
scenes.body: Two pump blood through the gills; a third pumps it around the body.

caption:
The most decentralised company in the ocean.

Octopus blood is blue: it uses a copper-rich protein, hemocyanin, to carry oxygen instead of iron-based haemoglobin.

Source: Smithsonian Ocean; National Geographic.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
